ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60:40 ratio of low-intensity (black) pixels concentrated in the central and trailing regions to high-intensity (white) pixels on the lateral lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous low-intensity (black) blob centered at the peduncle attachment and extending to the median notch. Lateral high-intensity (white) blobs on the distal halves of both lobes, featuring internal low-intensity (black) linear streaks and small scattered spots.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped notch with an estimated interior angle of 55 degrees and a vertical depth comprising approximately 12% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern across the entire trailing edge; distal tips show high-amplitude peaks (10-20 pixels) and deep valleys, while the inner lobe edges exhibit smaller, more consistent serrations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Moderate concave curvature from the median notch to the mid-lobe, transitioning to a sharp convex sweep at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed, high-contrast, multi-tonal (white/tan/gray) clusters with irregular textures located at the extreme distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark linear pixel disruptions visible on both lobes. Left lobe exhibits a vertical stroke intersected by a horizontal bar. Right lobe displays multiple divergent diagonal streaks.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive textured calcification/barnacle scarring at the distal tips; prominent dark linear rake marks on the white surfaces of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'T-shaped' dark pigmentation mark located in the upper high-intensity field of the left lobe.
